hsp029.name: HSP-029
hsp029.summary: Cut NEAR's maximum annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%, phased in over 24 months after a 90-day buffer.
hsp029.status: Approved by House of Stake vote (closed 2026-11-02, 99.97% of participating voting power in favour). Not in effect: needs ratification and a validator-adopted protocol upgrade. Live protocol config still reads 2.5% (evidence/protocol.json).
hsp029.use: Scenario only: issuance scaled by max_inflation / current max_inflation (the end state after the phase-in).

growth_paces.use: Reference yearly growth paces for the long-term table (a model, not a forecast). The table also shows two paces measured from the sample: the last 12 months and the fastest 12 months since 2023.

intents_buybacks.name: NEAR Intents fee buybacks
intents_buybacks.said_by: Sal Ternullo, CEO of the NEAR treasury company SVRN, on the Bankless podcast, reported by Stocktwits on 6 Oct 2026
intents_buybacks.status: External figure, not recomputed by Headroom. Intents fees are taken on swaps and mostly never appear as NEAR gas, so block headers cannot measure them. Other thesis-track entries that compute Intents revenue on-chain report a similar order (roughly a sixth of issuance).
intents_buybacks.use: Shown next to gas burn as the second value channel: buyback share of issuance = buyback_usd_30d / issuance_usd_30d.

hsp027.name: HSP-027
hsp027.summary: House of Stake proposal that ends the developer gas rebate, so gas fees are burned instead of partly paid to contracts.
hsp027.status: Passed. Headroom finds the change on chain at protocol 87 (evidence/protocol.json).
